children: Australian shares were poised to open higher on Friday, potentially supported by miners on strong commodity prices, while oil prices eased.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) rose 0.7%, a 133.5-point premium to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark ended up 0.4% on Thursday.
